description: This file defines the interface for an object ID set implementation, providing functions for initialization, insertion, removal, comparison, and iteration over sets of object IDs using hash structures. It is part of a library for managing sets of object identifiers efficiently.

classes.name: struct oidset
classes.description: Represents a set of object IDs, encapsulating a hash table for managing the IDs.

classes.name: struct oidset_iter
classes.description: Iterator struct for traversing the elements in an oidset.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initializes an oidset, optionally preallocating memory for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Checks if a given object ID is present in the set.

methods.name: oidset_equal
methods.description: Checks if two oidsets contain the same object IDs.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Inserts a copy of an object ID into the set, returning whether it was already present.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Adds all object IDs from a source set to a destination set.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Removes a specified object ID from the set.

methods.name: int oidset_size(const struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Returns the number of object IDs in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the set, freeing resources.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Reads object IDs from a file and adds them to the set.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Reads object IDs from a file with additional processing via callback.

methods.name: void oidset_iter_init(const struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse a set.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_next(struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Advances the iterator and returns the next object ID.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_first(struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Returns the first object ID in the set for iteration.
